newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos reports new pool onshore gas find.
newsitem.headline: Santos reports new pool onshore gas find.

text.p: Santos Ltd said it made a new pool gas discovery in the Merrimelia-Innamincka Block of the onshore Cooper Basin in South Australia.

The Merrimelia 37 appraisal well flowed gas at the rate of 6.37 million cubic feet per day with minor gas liquids in a test of the interval 2,271-2,300 metres in the Late Carboniferous Merrimelia Formation, Santos said.
The test was through a half-inch choke.
The well, which is located about 40 km north of the Moomba gas plant, has reached total depth of 2,385 metres and will be cased as a future new pool gas producer, Santos said.
"This is a good flow rate," said general manager South Australia Mike Hannell.
"The results open up a number of opportunities which will be pursued over the next 12 months," he said in a statement.
Santos, the operator, holds a 59.75 percent interest in the Merrimelia-Innamincka Block.

Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd, a unit of Exxon Corp, holds 20.21 percent, Boral Ltd's Boral Energy Resources Ltd has 13.19 percent, Crusader Resources NL 4.75 percent and Basin Oil NL, a unit of Cultus Petroleum NL, 2.1 percent.
